_about: The diagram styles (registers) our slide kit can draw, written as Choice options for Jev. 'what' is the look, 'use_for' and 'not_for' come from the content-shape rules in the course's diagram guide. Read 4 October 2026.

block_diagram.what: Boxes for systems and services with real product logos, connected by arrows, grouped in zones
block_diagram.use_for: how parts of a software system connect; where a component sits in an architecture; named products
block_diagram.not_for: numbers, measurements, order of steps over time, a single idea or a list

sequence_diagram.what: Vertical lifelines for each party with numbered arrows between them, top to bottom
sequence_diagram.use_for: who sends what to whom, in what order; request and response; a test procedure in steps
sequence_diagram.not_for: measured numbers, structure without order, comparisons

isometric_3d.what: 3D blocks, layers, funnels and cylinders drawn at an angle, with visible volume
isometric_3d.use_for: layers stacked on each other, a funnel that narrows, mass, pressure, how much of something there is
isometric_3d.not_for: exact measured values, step-by-step reasoning, text-heavy lists

hand_drawn_sketch.what: Whiteboard sketch with rough strokes, simple pastel shapes and red marker notes
hand_drawn_sketch.use_for: an everyday analogy, arithmetic worked step by step, a wrong idea crossed out and corrected, a simple concept sketch
hand_drawn_sketch.not_for: measured data, precise architecture, real screenshots

theme_cards.what: A row of coloured cards with an icon, a heading and one sentence each
theme_cards.use_for: three to five parallel themes or categories with nothing flowing between them
theme_cards.not_for: anything with steps, flow, order or numbers

lookup_map.what: Two spaces side by side, an ordered list on one side, scattered slots on the other, joined through a lookup table
lookup_map.use_for: a name or id that is translated to a place through a table
lookup_map.not_for: anything that is not a translation through a table

chart.what: A plotted chart with real axes and units: bars, lines or points
chart.use_for: measured numbers, latency, cost, accuracy, a distribution, a curve, a threshold on a scale
chart.not_for: ideas with no numbers, architecture, analogies

typographic_list.what: Large clean type on paper: a title card, a numbered list, a checklist, a quote
typographic_list.use_for: an agenda, a checklist, takeaways, a short quote, a title
typographic_list.not_for: mechanisms, flows, measured numbers that need a scale

side_by_side_panels.what: Two or three panels next to each other with the same rows, so the eye compares across
side_by_side_panels.use_for: comparing two or three things on the same points; before and after; a trade-off
side_by_side_panels.not_for: a single thing, a flow over time, many measured values

flowchart.what: A flowchart with boxes, decision diamonds and arrows
flowchart.use_for: a pipeline of steps, a decision tree, branches that depend on an answer

real_screenshot.what: A real screen capture of a web page, a console or a document
real_screenshot.use_for: showing a real page: a product console, a launch post, a book page, a source the viewer can visit
real_screenshot.not_for: explaining a mechanism, anything that is not a real page

real_terminal_capture.what: A real capture of a terminal or code editor on this computer
real_terminal_capture.use_for: a command and its real output; a real file of code
real_terminal_capture.not_for: concepts, anything that was not really run

illustrated_scene.what: A flat illustration of a person in a situation
illustrated_scene.use_for: a human moment: a person at work, a clerk, a customer

interactive_step_diagram.what: An in-app React Flow diagram that reveals nodes step by step when the viewer clicks
interactive_step_diagram.use_for: a lesson page on the website where the reader clicks through steps
interactive_step_diagram.not_for: a video slide rendered as a still 1920x1080 image (it cannot click)

shape_rules._about: Content shapes from the av-audit-gate content-shapes reference. A slide's shapes decide which registers are allowed. Jev never sees these codes.
